summary: Cosmic Footprints is an interactive bilingual web museum (Arabic & English) designed for school students. It brings NASA's silent and active space hardware including Apollo 11 EASEP, Opportunity, Viking, and Phoenix to life through first-person audio stories, simplified engineering specs, and interactive quizzes.
details:
What It Does & How It Works:

Cosmic Footprints is an interactive, bilingual (Arabic & English) educational web museum designed specifically for school students. Instead of reading heavy technical archives, students explore destinations on the Moon and Mars—featuring Apollo 11 EASEP, Opportunity Rover, Viking Program, and Phoenix Mars Lander—where each spacecraft tells its own story in the first person through expressive audio narrations, simplified engineering specs, and an interactive mini-quiz.

Impact & Creativity:

By combining storytelling, sound design, and native Arabic support alongside English, the platform makes NASA's silent and active space hardware relatable and inspiring for middle and high school students across Egypt and the Arab world.

Tools & Technologies Used:

Built using standard web development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) for the interactive user interface, official NASA Science and JPL data archives for scientific accuracy, Canva for presentation design, and text-to-speech audio tools for bilingual narration.
